gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro keeps its lowercase tall and its c wide open, a friendly plain sans that never raises its voice. Outrun Future sits above it, synthwave and stern.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-michroma: Michroma reads wide and slow, each letter given generous space on both sides and a tall body. And Outrun Future is the one that commands, its outline line holding one thickness like neon tubing.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre is approachable and modern. Outrun Future handles the authority, its wide-set synthwave letters leading, while Miriam Libre's wire-thin strokes and generous s shapes do the quiet work of being read.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-mochiy-pop-o: Professional in manner, Mochiy Pop One is oddly playful up close. Outrun Future delivers the synthwave authority, while Mochiy Pop One's huge lowercase eye and single stroke width keep the text legible.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-mochiy-pop-p: Outrun Future spaces its letters far apart and traces them in an outline of one constant width. Under it, Mochiy Pop P One stays clean and approachable, so a long passage reads with big lowercase and no brush-like swelling.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-montserrat-u: A constant-width outline, traced like neon, defines Outrun Future. Montserrat Underline follows with oversized lowercase and breathing counters, so a long passage moves along smoothly without any swelling in its round bowls.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-mozilla-head: Outrun Future sets wide-spaced letters whose curves hold their thickness right through the shoulders, with a synthwave edge. And Mozilla Headline reads in a friendly, contemporary way over a long passage, its big-bodied lowercase and splayed c terminals keeping things approachable.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-mozilla-text: Neutral and professional, Mozilla Text has tall lowercase that looks bold and terminals that flare outward, while Outrun Future above it keeps one constant pen pressure. Over a long stretch it reads sturdy.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-nata-sans: Outrun Future spaces its synthwave letters wide, with a large x-height and short ascenders. Nata Sans steadies the pair with a technical-pen steadiness and curves left wide, unclosed at the mouths.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-nobile: Neon-tube letters glow in Outrun Future, one steady line thickness throughout. Nobile does the quieter job, with open mouths and caps sitting barely above its x-height.
